desc:
🐾 Welcome to Pet Paradise! 🐾

How to Play:
🥚 Buy a pet or hatch a starter egg!
🦴 Equip your pet and let it explore your base!
💰 Your pets generate coins automatically!
🎁 Hatch rarer eggs & buy stronger pets!
🔁 Rebirth for a HUGE coin multiplier!
🏠 Upgrade your base & unlock powerful boosts!
💎 Evolve your pets into Golden & Diamond versions!
🌟 Hunt for ultra-rare HUGE pets!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and become the top collector!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
